goal: Add core domain models, initial Room schema, DAO boundaries, and schema versioning policy for native local data.
non_goals: Do not implement full repositories or feature UI.
Do not implement import/export transaction execution.
Do not implement encryption or Android Keystore secret storage.
Do not call real LLM providers.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
acceptance_criteria: Space is a first-class user-visible domain model with id, name, kind, created/updated timestamps, and optional sourceImportId.
Core domain models exist for sessions, messages, LLM profiles, memory/context items, graph, sources, background jobs, import batches, and export records.
Initial Room schema includes the core tables listed in ARCH section 6.2.
User-owned Room entities include spaceId where relevant.
DAO boundaries exist for spaces, sessions, messages, sources, graph, jobs, import batches, and export records.
Database versioning policy is explicit and test-covered.
Data layer compiles independently from UI modules.
Entity mapping and DAO smoke tests are present.
verification_expectations: Write failing tests before production model/schema implementation.
Run :core:data:connectedDebugAndroidTest if an ADB device is available.
Run native Gradle assembleDebug, test, and lint.
notes: This is a schema foundation task. Repositories and feature UI should be deferred to later tasks.
Room compiler configuration is allowed as part of the already-approved Room stack.
